name: Protagonist
source:
Father of Misaki, who likes to "play" with her and "check" on how is she doing. He hopes to reconcile with his wife and one day start living togheter again.
The protagonist was living alone since he was separated from his wife a few years back. One day he received a message from her telling him that their daughter was moving to his place, thinking it was a great opportunity to know each other and catch up after a long time.
